name: Sheshan
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Sheshan had no sons but daughters, and an Egyptian servant named Jarha; Israel was in Egypt at this time, with no land of inheritance to pass on.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Sheshan had no sons but daughters, and he gave his daughter to Jarha his Egyptian servant for a wife, and the line is carried down from their child.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 2: The Sons of Israel and the Line of Judah
